while True:
    v.append(n % m)
    n //= m
    if n == 0:

len_v = len(v)

mod = 1000000007

class Node:
    def __init__(self):
        self.v = [[0] * 35 for _ in range(35)]

def multiply(a, b):
    c = Node()
    for i in range(m + 1):
        for j in range(m + 1):
            for k in range(m + 1):
                c.v[i][j] = (c.v[i][j] + a.v[i][k] * b.v[k][j]) % mod
    return c

# Initialize arrays
S = Node()
T = [[Node() for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(len_v)]
s1 = [[Node() for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(len_v)]
s2 = [[Node() for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(len_v)]

# Build T, s1, s2
for i in range(len_v):
    if i == 0:
        for j in range(m):
            T[i][j].v[m][m] = 1
            for a in range(m):
                if a != j:
                    T[i][j].v[a][a] = 1
                    for b in range(m + 1):
                        T[i][j].v[a][b] = 1
    else:
        for j in range(m):
            if j == 0:
                s2[i][m - 1] = s2[i - 1][0]

    s1[i][0] = T[i][0]
    for j in range(1, m):
        s1[i][j] = multiply(s1[i][j - 1], T[i][j])
    s2[i][m - 1] = T[i][m - 1]
    for j in range(m - 2, -1, -1):
        s2[i][j] = multiply(T[i][j], s2[i][j + 1])

# Initialize S
for i in range(m + 1):
    S.v[0][i] = 1

j = 0
for i in range(len_v - 1, -1, -1):
    while v[i] > 0:
        S = multiply(S, T[i][j])
        j = (j + 1) % m
        v[i] -= 1

print(S.v[0][m])
